title: The joint scaling limit of critical Ashkin-Teller currents
main_claim: Take any point on the critical Ashkin-Teller line (sinh 2J = e^{-2U}, U <= J, including the 4-state Potts endpoint) and any bounded Jordan domain with any admissible polygonal approximation. Then the height H_delta converges to h/(pi sqrt g), with g = (8/pi) arcsin(sqrt(1+e^{4U})/2). Jointly with it, the wired and free current-cluster collections converge in the positive-diameter matching topology, and the boundary cluster converges in Hausdorff distance. The limits are canonical recursive two-valued local sets of the same GFF h: A_{-a,a} for the boundary cluster, and CLE4 followed by asymmetric splits for the free family, with a = (pi/2) sqrt g.

issues.location: Prop. plane-normalization (06-gaussian.tex), Sec. 4 preamble, App. A (10-input-conventions.tex)
issues.description: Several key inputs are imported from the companion paper DKLM2026: the regularity/log-moment estimate (Thm 4.5) on the whole range 1<=c<=2, the convergence criterion (Thm 8.1), and the free-energy correspondence that fixes the coefficient (Thms 4.3/4.4). Appendix A says that a literal reading of those proofs contains errors: a wrong path-length factor S', a wrong slope denominator (ML vs L), a lost (1-eps)^2 factor and reversed inclusions. The paper supplies its own fixes for these. So the final normalization kappa = 1/a^2, and the uniform moment bounds used throughout, depend on an external, still-changing source that cannot be checked here. This is not an identified gap in the paper's own argument.
issues.evidence: 'In [DKLM2026, Lemma 21.3], the printed path-length factor S' must be max{1,-S'}...'; 'Its printed denominator ML cannot apply to a single-column count'; 'We may therefore apply [DKLM2026, Theorems 4.3 and 4.4]: ... sigma^2 = 1/arcsin(c/2)'

coverage: I read in full: Sec. 1 (introduction), Sec. 2 (model, coupling, topology, main theorem, proof strategy), Sec. 4 (reflection positivity, Cauchy mixture, angular defect, plane Green covariance), Sec. 6 lines 1-1020 (flat-domain GFF, log moments, boundary decay, collision coefficient, Wick recursion, plane normalization), Lemma finite-cuts in Sec. 3, the visible-partition proposition and the local-finiteness corollary in Sec. 9, and Appendix A. Computations I checked by hand: (1) the parameter ranges: c in (1,2] and g in (4/3,4], with g=2 at U=0 and g=4 at e^{4U}=3. (2) Consistency of the normalizations H -> h/(pi sqrt g), K -> h/a and an odd-hole jump of 2a equal to a unit change in H. (3) Var K ~ log/(pi arccos Delta), with Delta = 1 - c^2/2; this matches the dimer value 2/pi^2 at Delta=0. (4) Rederived the per-edge (s,W,d) weights from the spin/edge table. (5) The Poisson average of ((b+iz)/(b-iz))^2 is ((b-s)/(b+s))^2. (6) The integral of (1-chi) dl is 4 pi b. (7) Fourth harmonics in frames pi/4 apart cancel. (8) J = log(8/9). (9) f''(0) = -(pi-zeta)/2. (10) The Koebe growth bounds and the boundary Green bound 4 sqrt(d/|x-y|). All are correct. Not checked line by line: Sec. 3 (comparison, collar, counts, pattern comparison, contiguity), Sec. 5 (screening), Sec. 7 (local sets), Sec. 8 (local kernel, no-crossing), the rest of Sec. 9. The cited DKLM2026 theorems are taken as given.
